name: blog-cannibalization
description: > Detect keyword cannibalization across blog posts by extracting primary keywords from titles and headings, clustering semantically similar targets, and flagging posts competing for the same search intent. Supports a free local mode (file analysis) and a paid DataForSEO API mode that runs only after the user approves the call count. Outputs a severity-scored report with a recommended action per cluster (merge, differentiate, canonical, noindex, or no action). Use when the user says "cannibalizat
